title: Design System: RC General Contracting Inc

display.purpose: Large home H1; the recorded 1.02 line-height is implemented on mobile. See docs/design-finish.md for the existing desktop difference.

interior-heading.purpose: Shared compact H1 on services, contact, and 404; directly reconciled with the implemented heading ramp.

headline.purpose: Main section H2. Existing line-height and tracking differences are recorded in docs/design-finish.md.

body.purpose: Body text and inherited control text, with a 64ch reading measure.

title.purpose: Service titles and compact contact section headings.

introduction.purpose: Desktop home introduction; reduces at the tablet and mobile breakpoints.

navigation.purpose: Desktop header links; mobile uses 1rem. The inherited line-height difference is recorded in docs/design-finish.md.

label.purpose: Approved compact label role; current form labels inherit body size and line-height as recorded in docs/design-finish.md.

shadows.name: focus-contrast-ring
shadows.purpose: Contrast ring beneath the focus outline; not decorative elevation.

motion.name: ease-standard

motion.name: duration-control
motion.purpose: Implemented button background and text-decoration colour transitions.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The shared enquiry and submit action, with underline hover and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--color-action, #a43120); color: var(--color-on-action, #fff); font: 600 1.125rem/1.6 var(--font-body, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1)), text-decoration-color 140ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1)); } .ds-button-primary:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #a43120); outline-offset: 5px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-bg, #f4f6f4); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary reveal button
components.description: The bordered contact-reveal control; this example shows its enabled state.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--color-action, #a43120); color: var(--color-on-action, #fff); font: 600 1.125rem/1.6 var(--font-body, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1)), text-decoration-color 140ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1)); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #a43120); outline-offset: 5px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-bg, #f4f6f4); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } } .ds-button-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #172d39); border: 1px solid var(--color-control-border, #687b82); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-soft, #dce5e7); }

components.name: Retry action
components.description: The underlined retry control shown when verification needs recovery.
components.css: .ds-retry { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #172d39); font: 400 1.125rem/1.6 var(--font-body, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 0; margin-left: 24px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-retry:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 0.65; } .ds-retry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #a43120); outline-offset: 5px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-bg, #f4f6f4); } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-retry { margin: 12px 0 0; } }

components.name: Labelled input
components.description: Persistent label, visible themed border, and associated error text. Labels inherit the implemented body size.
components.css: .ds-field { margin-bottom: 24px; color: var(--color-ink, #172d39); font: 400 1.125rem/1.6 var(--font-body, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); } .ds-field label { display: block; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field input { display: block; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-control-border, #687b82); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #172d39); caret-color: var(--color-action, #a43120); padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 48px; font: inherit; } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--color-error, #a43120); } .ds-field-error { color: var(--color-error, #a43120); font-size: 1rem; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-field-error:empty { display: none; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #a43120); outline-offset: 5px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-bg, #f4f6f4); }

components.name: Header navigation
components.description: Visible wrapping destinations, with underlined current and hover states. Mobile retains all three links.
components.html: ServicesAboutContact
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: flex; gap: 40px; flex-wrap: wrap; color: var(--color-ink, #172d39); font: 400 1.125rem/1.6 var(--font-body, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); } .ds-navigation a { min-inline-size: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-navigation a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-navigation a[aria-current] { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-navigation a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #a43120); outline-offset: 5px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-bg, #f4f6f4); } @media (max-width: 1023px) { .ds-navigation { gap: 24px; } } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-navigation { gap: 28px; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-navigation a { font-size: 1rem; } }

components.name: Interior heading
components.description: The implemented compact H1 used on services, contact, and the 404 page.
components.css: .ds-interior-heading { margin: 0; color: var(--color-ink, #172d39); font-family: var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(3rem, 5.5vw, 5rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-wrap: balance; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-interior-heading { font-size: 3rem; } }

narrative.status: Visual scope reviewed; scoped heading documentation reconciled. Release acceptance and Impeccable tool gates incomplete. No deployment.
narrative.overview:
**Rooms in focus** was selected by the owner through the Phase 2 comparison page on 23 September 2026. The home composition is a broad completed-kitchen photograph below a compact introduction, with a visible enquiry action. The supporting system uses open text layouts, real company imagery, and clear navigation.

This system was approved before implementation as the user requested. The source logo and photographs take precedence over generated details in the mockup. The full proposal, mobile treatment, and services-page composition remain in `docs/design-directions.md`, direction A. Copy was subsequently approved with the owner's release instruction. The scoped documentation reconciliation is recorded in `docs/design-finish.md`: the visual scope is reviewed, while release acceptance and Impeccable tool gates remain incomplete. No deployment has occurred.
dos: Do preserve all existing facts, testimonials, service scope, and the `#contact` anchor.
Do use original company assets and identify the rendering accurately.
Do keep the headline, purpose, and enquiry action visible early at 360px.
Do keep motion restrained and check real keyboard, screen-reader, and browser behaviour.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, project relationships, locations, guarantees, or timelines.
Don't ship a generated comp, generated room detail, or rasterized interface as page content.
Don't use Inter/system display faces, pure black/gray UI colours, purple-to-blue gradients, card nesting, gray text on coloured backgrounds, bounce, or elastic easing.
Don't claim quality gates have passed from design tokens or mockups alone.
